scientific.integrity: The finding specializes the printed Amos recurrence exactly at the source-permitted endpoint \(\beta=0\). The buffer asymptotic is proved from the autonomous scalar recurrence, after which summability and the positive-branch threshold follow from a convergent infinite product and series.
limitations: The second-moment coefficient is the allowed endpoint \(\beta=0\), not the default value.
The objective is a deterministic scalar strongly convex quadratic.
Optional momentum and gradient clipping are disabled.
The printed source normalization is used without an additional implementation-level denominator regularizer.
The sign-changing regime below the positive-branch threshold is not classified.

title: Amos can stall away from a scalar quadratic minimizer because its self-generated steps are summable
